headline: Goodwill writedown drives loss; adjusted EPS still beats
summary_short: Perrigo's Q1 2026 net sales fell 7.2% y/y to $969.2M as Self Care sales dropped 11.5%, and a $330.8M goodwill impairment from a segment realignment drove operating income to a $372.3M loss (from +$46.9M a year ago); adjusted EPS was $0.43, and FY2026 adjusted EPS guidance of $2.00-$2.30 was reaffirmed.
summary_long: Q1 2026 net sales fell 7.2% y/y to $969.2M (-12.7% q/q), driven by an 11.5% decline in Self Care on a milder cough-and-cold season and lower retailer inventory, partly offset by FX and a $21M tariff-refund benefit to gross profit (-17.0% y/y). A $330.8M non-cash goodwill impairment - triggered by Q1's shift from geographic to product-based reporting segments and fully wiping out Infant Formula and Oral Care goodwill - drove operating income to a $372.3M loss (from +$46.9M a year ago) and net loss to $398.6M. Adjusted EPS was $0.43 (all-in) and $0.40 (core), down y/y. Operating cash outflow widened to $113.6M; cash fell to $357.2M and equity to $2,498.8M. FY2026 adjusted EPS guidance ($2.00-2.30 all-in, $2.25-2.55 core) was reaffirmed.

drivers.explanation: Self Care net sales fell $70.9M (-11.5%) on a milder US/Europe cough-and-cold season and lower retailer inventory; Specialty Care (+4.0%) and Infant Formula (+2.1%) partly offset, while All Other (incl. Oral Care) fell 9.5%.
Segment operating income fell $44.3M (-39.3%) on carryover manufacturing-volume headwinds and lower sales flow-through, partly offset by tariff-refund recognition.
Fell $66.8M mainly on lower Self Care volumes (margin -400bps y/y), partly offset by roughly $21M of tariff refunds recognized after a court ruling voided certain import tariffs.
Fell $419.2M y/y: $66.8M from the gross-profit decline plus a $330.8M non-cash goodwill impairment from Q1's shift to product-based reporting units (Women's Health, Infant Formula, Oral Care).
Net loss widened on the same impairment and gross-profit decline, only partly offset by a lower 4.6% effective tax rate (vs 99.0% y/y) from released uncertain-tax-position reserves.
Outflow widened on lower earnings and higher working capital, which the company describes as in line with its own prior expectations.

Q1's shift from geographic to product-based reporting segments triggered a goodwill reallocation that fully impaired Infant Formula and Oral Care goodwill; FY2026 adjusted EPS guidance was reaffirmed unchanged.
